H1 2026: revenue 218,932,295, net profit 12,927,994; Q1 2026 + Q2 2026 = H1 2026 for revenue, cost, operating profit, profit before zakat, net profit and owners' profit. RESTATED, never substituted: Note 30 (FY2025 filing) corrects prepaid government (Iqama/work-permit) fees as an IAS 8 error: FY2024 net profit 8,445,501 -> 8,186,709, cost of revenue 208,624,984 -> 208,883,776, total assets 151,245,092 -> 149,442,492, equity 72,059,455 -> 70,256,855, EPS 0.24 -> 0.23, and CFO 35,988,610 -> 34,875,418 with financing -17,473,552 -> -16,360,360 (finance cost paid moved from financing to operating, 1,113,192) although the note says only profit before zakat and working capital are affected; 1 Jan 2024 equity 68,867,186 -> 67,323,378. Note 14 (H1 2026 filing) restates 6M 2025 net profit 3,273,403 -> 3,066,241 (Q2 2025 1,073,621 -> 1,170,233, Q1 2025 restated 1,896,008) and EPS 0.09 -> 0.05 (also reflects 21,000,000 bonus shares, capital 35,000,000 -> 56,000,000).
